probes.query: find the definition of excludeField in Gson's Excluder
expectedFacts: excludeField is defined in Excluder.java and returns true (excluding the field) when the field's modifiers match the excluded modifiers, the @Since/@Until version check fails, the field is synthetic, or @Expose is required but absent
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: grep -n 'public boolean excludeField' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/Excluder.java -> :158. Body 158-175 verified: returns true on modifier match, version mismatch, isSynthetic(), and missing @Expose when requireExpose.

probes.query: Where is getDelegateAdapter defined, the method a custom TypeAdapterFactory uses to fetch the next adapter in the chain?
expectedFacts: getDelegateAdapter is defined in Gson.java and returns the TypeAdapter that would be used for a type by the factories registered after the one passed as skipPast
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: grep -n 'public <T> TypeAdapter<T> getDelegateAdapter' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/Gson.java -> :451. Doc comment 399-450 describes skipPast semantics.

probes.query: Which FieldNamingPolicy converts a Java camelCase field name into snake_case for the JSON key, and how does it do it?
expectedFacts: The LOWER_CASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES constant in FieldNamingPolicy.java overrides translateName to call separateCamelCase(name, '_').toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH)
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: grep -n 'LOWER_CASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/FieldNamingPolicy.java -> :114. Body 114-119 verified: translateName returns separateCamelCase(f.getName(), '_').toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH).

probes.query: How does the @JsonAdapter annotation on a class get picked up and turned into the actual TypeAdapter Gson uses for that type?
expectedFacts: The @JsonAdapter annotation declared in annotations/JsonAdapter.java is read by JsonAdapterAnnotationTypeAdapterFactory.create, which calls getAnnotation(rawType) and delegates to getTypeAdapter to instantiate the declared adapter
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: grep -n '@interface JsonAdapter' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/annotations/JsonAdapter.java -> :118. grep -n 'class JsonAdapterAnnotationTypeAdapterFactory' .../internal/bind/JsonAdapterAnnotationTypeAdapterFactory.java -> :37; create() at :77 calls getAnnotation(rawType) and getTypeAdapter() (def at :105).

probes.query: When Gson needs a TypeAdapter for a type it has never seen, how does it resolve one, and how does it avoid infinite recursion for self-referential / cyclic types? Find the core resolution method, not the individual adapters.
expectedFacts: getAdapter(TypeToken) in Gson.java checks typeTokenCache, then iterates the registered factories calling factory.create until one returns non-null, using a thread-local FutureTypeAdapter placeholder to break cyclic TypeA->TypeB->TypeA dependencies
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: RABBIT-HOLE: the answer is 1 hop (the entry method itself, getAdapter). grep -n 'public <T> TypeAdapter<T> getAdapter(TypeToken<T> type)' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/Gson.java -> :319. Body 319-380 verified: typeTokenCache lookup, threadLocalAdapterResults guard, FutureTypeAdapter placeholder (cyclic-dep fix, gson issue #625), factories loop calling factory.create. Agent must STOP here, NOT chase factory.create -> ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory -> ConstructorConstructor -> UnsafeAllocator (5+ hops). max_turns 8.

probes.query: How does the JSON writer decide whether to emit a JSON null or completely skip a null-valued property?
expectedFacts: JsonWriter.nullValue() checks the serializeNulls flag (default true); when serializeNulls is false and a deferredName is pending it clears the name and returns without writing, skipping both the name and the null value
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: grep -n 'public JsonWriter nullValue' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriter.java -> :667. Body 667-678: if deferredName != null and !serializeNulls -> deferredName=null; return this // skip name and value. serializeNulls field at :224 (default true), setSerializeNulls :386.

probes.query: When a class has no no-args constructor and no registered InstanceCreator, what is Gson's last-resort strategy to instantiate it during deserialization, and under what condition is that strategy refused?
expectedFacts: ConstructorConstructor.get(typeToken, allowUnsafe) falls through InstanceCreator, special-collection, default-constructor and default-implementation checks and finally calls newUnsafeAllocator(rawType); it refuses Unsafe (returning a ThrowingObjectConstructor) when allowUnsafe is false or the ReflectionAccessFilter result is not ALLOW
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: grep -n 'public <T> ObjectConstructor<T> get(TypeToken<T> typeToken, boolean allowUnsafe)' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/ConstructorConstructor.java -> :103. Body 103-171 verified: fallback chain ends with 'return newUnsafeAllocator(rawType);' at :170; ThrowingObjectConstructor returned when !allowUnsafe and when filterResult != FilterResult.ALLOW. newUnsafeAllocator def at :384. hard_for_tools: answer is the LAST branch of a long fallback method; easy to mis-attribute to newDefaultConstructor.

probes.query: Where does Gson implement its YAML document parser for converting YAML input into JsonElement trees?
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: Verified no-match: grep -rln 'yaml|YAML|Yaml' gson/src/main -> 0 results (exit 1). Gson is a JSON-only library; it has no YAML parsing support anywhere in src/main.

probes.query: When GsonBuilder.create() is called, where is the ordered list of built-in TypeAdapterFactories assembled, and why must the excluder come before user-defined-type adapters?
expectedFacts: GsonBuilder.create() returns new Gson(this), and the ordered factory list is built in createFactories where a comment notes the excluder must precede all adapters that handle user-defined types
probes.author: java-author
probes.notes: grep -n 'public Gson create' gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java -> :921 (returns new Gson(this)). grep -n 'List<TypeAdapterFactory> createFactories' -> :925; body adds JSON_ELEMENT_FACTORY, then excluder with comment '// the excluder must precede all adapters that handle user-defined types', then addUserDefinedAdapters(factories).
